lighting_shading.note: Warm overhead light softens wool and illuminates the forest.

value_contrast.note: Dark muzzle and hands punctuate the bright wool.

color_palette.note: Red scarf and golden bow contrast with yellow-green foliage.

composition_hierarchy.note: Face and drawn arrow lead attention across the upper body.

shape_proportions.note: Bulbous fleece contrasts with the slender bow and arrows.

viewpoint_depth.note: Foreground leaves frame the sheep against receding forest trunks.

edges_linework.note: Shaded contours define forms without continuous drawn outlines.

surface_finish.note: Wool becomes smooth sculpted curls rather than individual fibers.

rhythm_staging.note: Extended arms and taut bowstring animate repeated rounded fleece curls.
